annotation.emotional_arc: longing and unresolved search for lost memories

stanzas.loss_note: The translation is highly faithful, though the subtle grammatical ambiguity of who is unable to return (the memories themselves, or the person searching) is slightly flattened in the English rendering.

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: The elusive nature of past memories which cannot be easily located or retrieved.
acceptable_visual_variants: A person looking at a blank map where streets fade into mist
A hand holding a key that fits no door in a street of closed houses
metaphor_spans.literal_meaning: The physical address or location of memories
metaphor_spans.literalization_risk: Showing a literal envelope or mailbox with the word 'Memories' written on it, which misses the psychological depth of searching one's mind.

transferred_attributes: being searchable in a physical space

metaphor_spans.tenor: the accessibility or retrieval of past memories
metaphor_spans.vehicle: a physical address or home location
metaphor_spans.visualization_strategy: Depict a person standing at a misty, empty crossroads looking at a blank signpost or holding an empty, unaddressed envelope.

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: Trying every possible way or searching through every mental avenue to recall or reconnect with the past.
acceptable_visual_variants: A row of ancient, closed wooden doors fading into a dark background with a hand reaching out to touch one
A person walking down a corridor of closed doors, each slightly glowing with a different color representing a past era
metaphor_spans.literal_meaning: Physically knocking on every door in a neighborhood
metaphor_spans.literalization_risk: Depicting a literal salesman or visitor knocking on wooden doors in a modern street, losing the poetic sense of searching for lost time.

transferred_attributes: repeated attempts to gain entry or access

metaphor_spans.source_span_original: हर दरवाजे पे दस्तक देने के बाद
metaphor_spans.source_term: हर दरवाजे पे दस्तक देने के बाद
metaphor_spans.tenor: searching through different mental paths or past associations
metaphor_spans.visualization_strategy: Show a shadowy figure standing before a series of closed, semi-translucent doors that reveal faint, unreachable memories behind them.

translation_loss.what_was_lost: The translation resolves the ambiguous subject of the verb 'laut paate' (लौट पाते) as 'they' (referring to memories), whereas the Hindi verb form is grammatically plural/honorific and could also refer to the speaker/seekers ('we/I') who are unable to return after wandering. This rich grammatical ambiguity of subject is flattened in English.
The rhythmic and phonetic flow of the Hindi phrasing, particularly the internal rhyme and cadence of 'milta' (मिलता) and 'paate' (पाते), is lost in the literal English translation.

annotation.theme: The elusive nature of memories and the inability to retrieve them despite searching everywhere.

original_poem:
यादों का पता नहीं मिलता,
हर दरवाजे पे दस्तक देने के बाद,
हर गली में घूमते हुए,
फिर भी न लौट पाते।
translated_poem:
The address of memories is not found,  
After knocking on every door,  
Roaming in every street,  
Yet, they do not return.
